summary: designer-stats and designer-compare must treat free/POD/sale/price/type mix as metrics from a bounded scanned sample (--max-scan-pages), label sampled=true when scanned < total_products, and must not walk the full catalog.
reason: A designer's catalog can exceed Algolia's 1000-hit window. Exhaustive paging burns the shared public search key and still cannot cover the whole catalog; the durable contract is an explicit sample with total_products from nbHits.
